info.name: AngelNest Parent App API
info.description:
The AngelNest parent app's API — sign in by text code, read and send messages in the same conversations as the staff **Messages** page.

## Two servers to point it at
Change `base_url` on the collection's **Variables** tab (then Ctrl+S):

| Server | base_url | Sign-in code | Parents |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Your local AngelNest** (default) | `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/parent` | Written to `storage\logs\laravel.log` — copy it into `code` | Real parents in your local data |
| **Sandbox** | `http://127.0.0.1:8124/api/parent` | Filled in for you | Made-up (table below) |

**Local (port 8000):** set `phone` to the mobile of a parent with **Texts** ticked on an Active or Pending child. After request 1, get the code with
```
Select-String "AngelNest code" storage\logs\laravel.log | Select-Object -Last 1
```
put the 6 digits in `code`, save, then run 2. Nothing is texted (no Twilio locally), but what you send is saved in your local data.

**Sandbox (port 8124):** start it with
```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\parent-app-sandbox.ps1
```

| Phone | Who | Expect |
|---|---|---|
| 585-555-0134 | Kate — Mia + Leo | Signs in |
| 585-555-0135 | Dan — Mia | Same Mia conversations as Kate |
| 585-555-0177 | Olivia — Ava | Only Ava's |
| 585-555-0188 | Texts not ticked | No code |
| 585-555-0199 | Court restriction | No code |

## Run in order
**0** checks the connection. **1 → 2** sign in (the token is saved and sent automatically). **4** picks a conversation. The rest use what earlier requests saved.

**Staff side:** `/messages` on the same server (port 8000: your usual login · sandbox: director@sandbox.test / sandbox-pass). Send from there, then press **6** in Postman to see it arrive.

**Errors:** `401` sign in again · `404` not this parent's · `422` check `errors` · `429` wait a minute.

Full guide: `docs/parent-app-api.md`.

item.name: 1. Sign in

exec: console.log(r.signed_in ? 'Connected and signed in as ' + r.parent.name : 'Connected, not signed in yet (run 1 and 2).');

request.description:
Is Postman reaching the server, and are you signed in? Press **Send** — the **Test Results** tab and the **Console** say which.

**Answer 200**
```json
{ "connected": true, "api": "parent", "centre": "Little Angels Day Care Center", "server_time": "2026-11-06T09:49:00-05:00", "signed_in": true, "parent": { "id": 1, "name": "Kate Testwell" } }
```
- **Could not send request / ECONNREFUSED** — the server is not running, or `{{base_url}}` points at the wrong place.
- `"signed_in": false` — connected, but no token yet (or it expired): run 1 and 2.

exec: if (r.debug_code) { pm.collectionVariables.set('code', r.debug_code); console.log('Sandbox code saved: ' + r.debug_code); }

else { console.log('Code sent. Local server: read it from storage/logs/laravel.log (Select-String "AngelNest code" storage\\logs\\laravel.log | Select-Object -Last 1), put it in the code variable, save, then run 2.'); }

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit sign-in code by text to the parent's mobile.

**Body**
```json
{ "phone": "585-555-0134" }
```
Any format works — `(585) 555-0134`, `5855550134`, `+15855550134`.

**Answer 200** (always the same, so nobody can find out which numbers are on file)
```json
{ "sent": true, "expires_in": 600, "message": "If that number is on file, a code is on its way." }
```
Where the code goes:
- **Local (port 8000):** to `storage\logs\laravel.log` — run `Select-String "AngelNest code" storage\logs\laravel.log | Select-Object -Last 1`, put the digits in `{{code}}`, save.
- **Sandbox (port 8124):** the answer also has `"debug_code"`, saved into `{{code}}` for you.
- **A real server with Twilio:** a text to the phone — type it into `{{code}}`.

**Rules:** the code lasts 10 minutes and allows 5 tries; asking again replaces it.

**Errors:** `422` no phone · `429` more than 5 requests a minute (or 10 an hour for one number).

exec: console.log('Signed in as ' + r.parent.name + '; token saved.');

request.description:
Checks the code and signs the parent in.

**Body**
```json
{ "phone": "585-555-0134", "code": "427209", "device_name": "Postman" }
```

**Answer 200**
```json
{
  "token": "1|akGrJPdF…",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in_days": 90,
  "parent": { "id": 1, "name": "Kate Testwell", "children": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Mia Testwell", … } ], … }
}
```
The token is saved into `{{token}}` and the first child's id into `{{child_id}}`. The token lasts 90 days.

**Errors:** `422` — "That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one."

item.description:
A parent signs in with their **mobile number** and a **6-digit code** sent by text — no password.

Run **0** to check the connection, then **1** and **2**. Request 2 saves the token, and every other request sends it automatically (`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`).

Only a parent with **Texts** ticked on a child's record, no restriction, and the child Active or Pending can sign in.

item.name: 2. Conversations

exec: if (pick) { pm.collectionVariables.set('thread_id', pick.id); console.log('thread_id = ' + pick.id + ' (' + pick.kind_label + ' · ' + pick.title + ')'); }

request.description:
The parent's conversations, newest first. Saves the first one they can reply to into `{{thread_id}}`.

**Answer 200**
```json
{
  "threads": [
    {
      "id": 1, "kind": "room", "kind_label": "Room · Toddler", "title": "Mia Testwell",
      "child": { "id": 1, "name": "Mia Testwell" },
      "can_reply": true, "unread": 1,
      "last_message": { "id": 1, "preview": "Picnic Friday, please bring sunscreen.", "from_me": false, "sent_at": "2026-11-06T09:49:00-05:00" },
      "last_message_at": "2026-11-06T09:49:00-05:00"
    }
  ]
}
```
- `unread` — messages after the parent's read mark that they did not write.
- `can_reply` is `false` for announcements.

One conversation: the thread and its newest messages, **oldest first**. Saves the last message id into `{{last_message_id}}`.

**Query:** `limit` 1–100 (default 50).

**Answer 200**
```json
{
  "thread": { …same as in the inbox… },
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": 2, "thread_id": 1,
      "from": { "type": "centre", "name": "Ray · Toddler", "is_me": false },
      "body": "Picnic Friday, please bring sunscreen.",
      "media": [ { "kind": "photo", "url": "https://…signed link…" } ],
      "channel": "sms",
      "sent_at": "2026-11-06T09:49:00-05:00"
    }
  ]
}
```
- `from.type` — `centre` (staff) or `parent`. `from.is_me` — this parent's own message (show on the right).
- `channel` — `sms` (a text) or `app`.
- `media.url` works for 30 days without a token.

**Errors:** `404` — not this parent's conversation (or `{{thread_id}}` is empty: run 4 first).

exec: if (!m.length) console.log('No new messages. Send one from the staff Messages page, then press Send here again.');

request.description:
**See staff messages arrive in Postman.** Postman cannot receive a push, so it asks:

1. Send a message to this family from the staff **Messages** page.
2. Press **Send** here.
3. The new message is in the answer, and the **Console** (View → Show Postman Console) prints it as `NEW  Ray · Toddler: Picnic Friday!`.

Only messages newer than `{{last_message_id}}` come back, and the newest id is saved, so pressing Send again shows only what came after. Empty `messages` means nothing new yet.
The page of messages **before** `before_id` — for when the parent scrolls up past the first page. Same answer shape as 5. Use `limit` for the page size.

A message from the parent into the conversation. It appears on the staff Messages page as *"Kate Testwell · via the parent app"*.

**Body** — `body`, `media`, or both
```json
{ "body": "Hello from Postman! See you Friday." }
```
`body` up to 1600 characters; `media` up to 4 items from request 11.

**Answer 201**
```json
{ "message": { "id": 5, "from": { "type": "parent", "name": "You", "is_me": true }, "body": "Hello from Postman! See you Friday.", "media": [], "channel": "app", "sent_at": "…" } }
```

**Errors:** `404` not this parent's conversation · `422` empty message, or the conversation is an **announcement** (one-way — use request 10 to write to the office).

Moves the parent's read mark, so `unread` in the inbox goes to 0.

**Body**
```json
{ "last_message_id": 5 }
```
Send `{}` to mark everything read. The app calls this when a conversation is opened and when new messages arrive while it is open.

**Answer 200:** `{ "last_read_id": 5 }`

item.name: 10. Start an Office conversation about a child

exec: if (t) { pm.collectionVariables.set('thread_id', t.id); console.log('thread_id = ' + t.id + ' (' + t.kind_label + ')'); }

request.description:
Finds — or opens, if there is none yet — the conversation of that kind about one child, and saves it into `{{thread_id}}`. Use it for a **"Message the office"** button, or to reply to an announcement.

**URL:** `/children/{{child_id}}/threads` — the child id from request 2 or 3.

**Body**
```json
{ "kind": "office" }
```
`kind`: `office` (office and director only) or `room` (the child's teachers and the director).

**Answer 200:** `{ "thread": { "id": 5, "kind": "office", "kind_label": "Office", "title": "Leo Testwell", … } }`

**Errors:** `404` — not this parent's child · `422` — kind is not room or office.

item.description:
The parent's inbox and conversations — the **same conversations** the staff Messages page shows.

| kind | Badge | Can reply |
|---|---|---|
| `room` | Room · *classroom* | Yes |
| `office` | Office | Yes |
| `ann` | Announcement | No |

Run **4** first: it saves a conversation into `{{thread_id}}` for 5–9.

item.name: 3. Photos

request.description:
Uploads a photo or video. Then send it with request 12.

**How:** Body tab → **form-data** → on the `file` row click **Select Files** and pick a file.

Accepted: jpeg, png, gif, webp, heic, mp4, mov, webm — up to 100 MB.

**Answer 201**
```json
{ "path": "messages/media/parent-1/abc123.jpg", "kind": "photo", "url": "https://…signed link…" }
```
`path` and `kind` are saved into `{{upload_path}}` and `{{upload_kind}}`.

Sends the photo uploaded in request 11 into `{{thread_id}}`, with a line of text. It shows on the staff Messages page with the photo.

**Body**
```json
{ "body": "A photo from Postman", "media": [ { "path": "{{upload_path}}", "kind": "{{upload_kind}}" } ] }
```
Only paths from **this parent's own** uploads are accepted.

**Errors:** `422` — `media.0.path` empty (run 11 first) or not this parent's upload.

item.description: A photo or video is two steps: **upload** the file (11), then **send** a message with the saved path (12).

item.name: 4. Push and sign out

request.description:
Tells the server where to send push notifications for this parent. The real app sends the Expo push token it gets from `expo-notifications`.

**Body**
```json
{ "push_token": "ExponentPushToken[postman-test]", "platform": "ios" }
```
`platform`: `ios`, `android` or `web`.

**Answer 201:** `{ "registered": true }`

**Try it:** after registering, send a message from the staff Messages page — in the sandbox a `[push]` line appears in `storage/logs/laravel.log` (title like *"Mia · Toddler"*, the message as the body).

Stops push notifications to this phone. The app calls this when the parent signs out.

**Body**
```json
{ "push_token": "ExponentPushToken[postman-test]" }
```

**Answer 200:** `{ "forgotten": true }`

Deletes the token on the server and clears `{{token}}`. Any request after this answers `401` until you run 1 and 2 again.

**Answer 200:** `{ "signed_out": true }`

item.description: Register the phone for push notifications after sign-in; forget it and sign out when the parent signs out.

item.name: 5. Version 2: the day, photos, calendar, absence, pickup
item.description: Added 9 Nov 2026. docs/parent-app-api.md §4.12–4.17. Sign in first (requests 1–3) so `{{token}}` and `{{child_id}}` are set.

request.description:
Where the child is today, from the register and the door kiosk. Add `?date=YYYY-MM-DD` for another day (§4.12).

**Answer 200**
```json
{
  "date": "2026-11-09",
  "status": { "state": "checked_in", "time": "2026-11-09T08:05:00-05:00", "by": "Kate Testwell" },
  "totals": null,
  "entries": [ { "id": 12, "time": "…", "type": "checkin", "title": "Checked in", "detail": "Dropped off by Kate Testwell" } ],
  "note": null
}
```
`state`: `checked_in` · `checked_out` · `absent` · `not_arrived`. `totals` and `note` are `null`: meals, naps and notes aren't recorded at the centre yet.

**Errors:** `404` — not this parent's child · `422` — bad date.

Photos staff sent in this parent's conversations about the child, and in announcements, by day, newest first, 7 days a page (§4.13).

**Answer 200:** `{ "groups": [ { "date", "label": "TODAY", "caption", "photos": [ { "id", "thumb_url", "full_url", "taken_at" } ] } ], "next_page": null }`

The links are signed and need no token.

The days the centre is closed in a month (§4.14). Leave out `month` for this month.

**Answer 200:** `{ "month": "2026-11", "events": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2026-11-26", "kind": "closed", "title": "Thanksgiving", "detail": null } ] }`

exec: const d = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000); pm.collectionVariables.set('tomorrow', d.toISOString().slice(0, 10));

request.description:
Tell the room a child will be away (§4.15). `{{tomorrow}}` is filled in for you.

`reason`: `sick` · `appointment` · `family` · `vacation` · `other`. `symptoms` (only with `sick`): `fever` · `cough` · `stomach` · `rash`.

**Answer 201:** `{ "absences": [ { "id", "child_id", "date", "reason" } ] }`

Also posted in the child's **Room** conversation — open `/messages` on the staff side to see it. DSS marks are not touched.

**Errors:** `404` — not this parent's child · `422` — a past date, a repeated date, or an unknown reason.

Who may collect the child, and who the parent said is coming today (§4.16). Saves the first person into `{{pickup_person_id}}`.

**Answer 200:** `{ "code": null, "expires_at": null, "code_hint": "Use your own door PIN…", "people": [ { "id", "name", "relation", "is_parent" } ], "today_person_id": null }`

`code` is always `null`: door PINs are per adult and stored only as hashes.

Someone on the pick-up list is collecting today. Answers the same object as request 20, and posts a note in the child's **Office** conversation.

**Errors:** `422` on `person_id` — not on the pick-up list · `404` — not this parent's child.

A one-time person for today. Answers `201` with the object from request 20; they appear with `"id": 0, "one_time": true`. They are **never** added to the pick-up list — the note in the Office conversation asks staff to check photo ID.

Which pushes this parent wants (§4.17). Everything is on until changed.

**Answer 200:** `{ "messages": true, "announcements": true, "daily": true, "photos": true }`
Send any of `messages`, `announcements`, `daily`, `photos` as booleans. Answers the full set. With `messages` off, staff messages no longer push to this parent (texts are unaffected).
